collection.mode: Retained successful eth_call results; no RPC re-query during artifact persistence.
collection.statePinning: Each observation group used an explicit blockNumber. Factory, hook/assets and example curve groups are different blocks, not one atomic snapshot.
collection.timeSemantics: UTC times are RPC block timestamps, not separately recorded HTTP retrieval wall-clock times.
collection.approvalMethod: approvedPairTokens(address) for all 469 catalog candidates, sequential multicall groups of at most 100 contracts, pinned to block 102120668; pairTokenEconomics(address) for all 85 approved candidates at the same block.
collection.approvalReconstruction: The retained collector output contained every true approval and an empty errors array. All 469 addresses were recovered from the matching original catalog snapshot. False observations are the successful false results omitted by that collector's output filter, reconstructed by set difference; they are not new calls or inferred approval policy.

candidateCatalog.hashCaveat: Hash measured during persistence; no hash was recorded during the original RPC scan. Indexed time, block, count and retained approved rows match the original catalog evidence.

nativeQuote.approvalNote: Native ETH is the separate zero-address launch path, not one of the 469 ERC-20 approval observations.

exampleLaunchFeePolicy.scope: Snapshot for this existing launch; not substituted for the factory's current policy for new launches.

approvedAssetsFieldProvenance.address: Original catalog candidate used as RPC argument.
approvedAssetsFieldProvenance.symbol: Original catalog metadata, not a symbol() call made by this research pass; identity must use the address.
approvedAssetsFieldProvenance.decimals: Third return value of the live factory pairTokenEconomics(address) call, not a fresh ERC-20 decimals() call.
approvedAssetsFieldProvenance.phantomQuote: First return value of live pairTokenEconomics(address), raw integer string.
approvedAssetsFieldProvenance.graduationThreshold: Second return value of live pairTokenEconomics(address), raw integer string.

plannerDerivations.evidenceBasis: Mathematical derivation from retained parameters and official curve documentation; not additional on-chain observations.
plannerDerivations.integerPolicy: Parse all raw quantity strings as arbitrary-precision integers. Preserve each asset's observed P and T independently; do not regenerate T as 2.5 times P. Decimal strings must not pass through Number.

openingFdvQuote.meaning: Initial fully diluted valuation in whole quote units, not deposited quote liquidity or a USD target.

graduationTargetQuote.meaning: Net real quote target, not cumulative gross buyer spend or market cap.

idealTerminalCurveFdvQuote.caveat: Ideal continuous pre-graduation curve value, ignoring integer rounding. This is not a verified V4 pool initialization price.

plannerDerivations.progressCaveat: Tokens-sold allocation percentage and quote-raised percentage do not agree between endpoints despite wording in the docs.
plannerDerivations.buyNetQuoteRaw: gross - floor(gross * feeBps / B) - floor(gross * creatorTaxBps / B) - floor(gross * appliedSnipeTaxBps / B)
plannerDerivations.sellNetQuoteRaw: amountOutRaw(tokensIn, tokenReserve, quoteReserve) minus separately floored base-fee and creator-tax amounts on that gross output; no snipe tax on sells
plannerDerivations.quoteReserveSource: getReserves(), including phantom quote and excluding accrued fees; not realQuoteReserve().
plannerDerivations.partialFill: If computed tokensOut > sellableTokens(), cap output at sellableTokens(), compute netNeeded with amountInRaw, spent = min(requestedGross, ceil(netNeeded * B / (B - feeBps - creatorTaxBps - appliedSnipeTaxBps))), and refund requestedGross - spent. minTokensOut is rate-based under partial fills.
plannerDerivations.lifecycle: Separate curve first, then actual Uniswap v4 pool creation at graduation; not direct V4 liquidity at launch.
plannerDerivations.quoteStopConditions: Stop buys when sellableTokens() is zero. Stop sells when readyToGraduate() is true, even before graduated() becomes true. Route phase 2 trades through V4.
plannerDerivations.feePolicy: One immutable creator surcharge for both directions; no independently configurable buy and sell creator taxes in the documented TokenParams. Protocol takes 30% of base fees; optional buyback takes 50% of the remaining creator base-fee share. Creator tax is entirely creator-directed. Existing launches retain their snapshots.
plannerDerivations.buybackMeaning: buybackBurnBps is the contract getter name, but bought-back launch tokens are locked in a weighted five-year vest, not burned.
plannerDerivations.postGraduationFees: Core LP fee is zero. Hook collects from the unspecified swap currency: output for exact-input, input for exact-output. Do not reuse curve fee arithmetic for V4. Fee conversion and buyback sweeps have separate mechanics.

missingEvidence: No missing phantomQuote, graduationThreshold or factory-recorded decimals among the 85 approved ERC-20 rows.
No approval-read failures among the 469 catalog candidates; approval coverage outside that candidate set is unknown.
Economics for the 384 non-approved candidates were not queried and are intentionally absent, not zero-filled.
Original raw JSON-RPC request/response envelopes and block hashes were not persisted; this artifact retains decoded tool results and explicit block numbers.
Fresh explorer-verified source, deployed-bytecode/source equality, exact V4 hook fee rounding and exact graduation pool-seeding math were not established because source fetches returned 403.
Factory current-new-launch full fee-policy tuple was not successfully read directly; hook defaults and one existing launch's snapshot were read and are distinguished above.
The exact exponential opening-tax decay function was not freshly source-verified. Use currentSnipeTaxBps(recipient) for execution-time quoting rather than inventing a decay formula.
Creator-tax combined cap and other historical internal caps were not freshly verified; attempted public constant getters reverted.

No fresh per-token symbol(), ERC-20 decimals(), bridge-backing or issuer-attestation verification was performed by this Pons pass. Symbols and issuer classifications come from the catalog; quote decimals come from the factory.
No USD oracle observations were taken. Quote presets are raw quote quantities, not fixed USD valuations.
No exhaustive factory-event allowlist enumeration, hybrid basket liquidity, derivatives, leverage or arbitrary unapproved quote-asset support was established.
usageCaveats: Research snapshot only; Pons approvals are not Plugged deployment authorization or proof of an existing Plugged launch.
Current settings for new launches can change. Existing launches use their snapshotted configuration. Re-read and pin launch economics before constructing transactions.
The application was draft-only during this research; no launch, approval transaction or trade was submitted.
Approved assets are one quote currency per launch. Names, symbols, provider category labels and approval status do not establish backing or product safety.
Pons and pools.trade are separate protocols. Pons V2 begins on a separate bonding curve and creates the V4 pool only at graduation.
